## Problem 1
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The `penguins` dataset contains information about penguins, including species, island, bill length, bill depth, flipper length, body mass, sex, and year. The `species` variable includes Adelie, Chinstrap, and Gentoo penguins, and the `island` variable includes Biscoe, Dream, and Torgersen. The dataset contains `r nrow(penguins)` observations and `r ncol(penguins)` variables. The mean flipper length is `r round(mean(penguins$flipper_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE), 2)` mm.

```{r}
ggplot(
  penguins,
  aes(
    x = bill_length_mm,
    y = flipper_length_mm,
    color = species
  )
) +
  geom_point()

ggsave("penguins_scatterplot.png")
```
